description:
Build a LOCAL Odoo image on the box from the official .deb - for a major that has no
    official `odoo:<version>` image yet (20, as of 2026-09-25). Recipe = the official odoo/docker
    19.0 one: ubuntu:noble (Python 3.12) + the .deb + wkhtmltox. Community: leave deb_path empty
    and the public nightly .deb is downloaded → `odoo-local:<version>-ce`. Enterprise: place YOUR
    licensed .deb on the box and pass its path + subscription_confirmed=true → `odoo-local:
    <version>-ee`, the enterprise addons INSIDE the image (no docker_ee_mount). The tag is set from
    the edition read out of the built image, so both editions coexist and neither build replaces
    the other. The image never leaves the box. Then run docker_stack_init(..., versions=[...,
    version], local_images=[version]) and, for the -ee image, enterprise=[version] too.
    dry_run shows the script.
name: docker_image_build
